name: EPIC 246022761
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 14.8 solar radii and 0.79 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,914 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.79 solar masses and 14.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,628 K at its surface.
